Phase 1 (App shell) is implemented and verified:

- **`app.config.ts`** — added `health` and `transcribe` entries to `source.entry` and `router`, alongside the existing `main`/`second`.
- **`src/pages/main/App.vue`** — rebuilt as the Home screen: title `Native Bench`, subtitle `Token economics benchmark`, and `Health`/`Transcribe` buttons that navigate via `sparkling-navigation`'s `router.open`, mirroring the app's existing multi-page pattern.
- **`src/pages/health/`** and **`src/pages/transcribe/`** (new) — static placeholder screens matching §3.2/§3.3 exactly (status lines, `Request Access` enabled, second action button visually disabled, section header/empty states), each with a back link using `close()` to return to Home.

Verified: `npm run build` succeeds, `xcodebuild ... build` succeeds (the specified completion gate), and I installed/launched the built app directly on a booted simulator (bypassing an unrelated broken `pod install`/Ruby toolchain issue triggered only by `npm run run:ios`) — it launches without crashing and the Home screen renders correctly per spec (screenshot confirmed). No changes were made outside `src/pages` and `app.config.ts`; `SPEC.md` and `spec-assets/` are untouched.
